meta.title: skip unnecessary alias-check in collect(::AbstractArray) from copyto\!
meta.body_summary: Replace copyto! with copyto_unaliased! in specific _collect_indices methods to skip an unnecessary aliasing check on newly created arrays, improving performance for custom array types (e.g., GarbageVector from 179 ns to 30 ns).
